segments.name: Financial services
products: prepaid, cash, debit and credit cards
segments.description: Provides financial technology and payment solutions, including digital banking, card issuing and acquiring, to consumers and SMEs in Brazil.
segments.evidence: the PagSeguro Group and its subsidiaries operate in a single segment, as financial service agents.

revenueModel.text: Merchants and consumers pay the company for payment processing (MDR), card issuing, banking services and prepayment of credit card receivables.
revenueModel.evidence: diversify revenue streams beyond MDR and the prepayment of credit card receivables.

changes.text: In 2023, PagSeguro Brazil acquired the remaining shares of NetPOS and merged RegistraSeguro S.A. into PagSeguro Brazil.
changes.evidence: In July 2023, PagSeguro Brazil acquired 90% of the shares of NetPOS, in addition to the 10% it had previously acquired, and it therefore reached 100% of the share capital of NetPOS; and

changes.text: In 2024, PagSeguro set up the FIDM fund to anticipate third-party assignments in accordance with market operations.
changes.evidence: In June 2024, PagSeguro set up the Fundo de Investimento em Direitos Creditórios – PagBank Multiadquirência – Responsabilidade Limitada, or FIDM.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company contributed PagSeguro Brazil shares to BS Holding and completed a partial spin-off of BS Holding in December 2025.
changes.evidence: In December 2025, we completed a partial spin-off of BS Holding pursuant to which a portion of the shares of PagSeguro Brazil held by BS Holding was transferred directly to the Company as its shareholder.
